paraphrase: Being per se is said in two ways: as divided by the ten categories, which only what posits something in reality is; and as signifying the truth of propositions, which anything is of which an affirmative proposition can be formed, even if it posits nothing in reality (privations and negations).
note: Source reading behind the adopted concrete sense (#1103). It is no premise of any argument. No Lean declaration: the in-re/propositional distinction enters Lean only through HasEsseInRe, which reads InAct x esse as being in the first way.
